scope: Pure statistical module, mock-only tests and supplied test log. No actual arm caches, outputs, or outcome tables read.

coverage_checked: 598 observed pairs and two unavailable whole pairs in a 600-pair mock
all 16 binary completions for four unavailable outcomes
scheduled difference bounds of observed difference sum plus or minus two, divided by 600
exact two-sided conditional McNemar criterion across every completion
20,000-draw bootstrap with frozen seed and selected-case order
completion bootstrap equivalence to frozen paired statistics on an interleaved mock
final-phase gate before outcome-bearing inputs are iterated
rejection of partial pairs, duplicate or mismatched IDs, empty allowlist, and response imputation

review_findings.whole_pair_completions: Correctly enumerates all binary assignments for two unavailable whole pairs.
review_findings.difference_bounds: Correctly bounds the all-scheduled-pair difference by (observed_sum - 2)/600 through (observed_sum + 2)/600.
review_findings.primary_criterion: Requires positive repair-minus-fresh difference and exact two-sided McNemar p below 0.05 for every completion.
review_findings.bootstrap: Uses common seeded resampling over frozen selected-case order; mock tests compare each completion to the frozen paired-statistics helper.
review_findings.no_imputation: Hypothetical binary values are labeled as sensitivity assignments; identity validation rejects a response on an unavailable row.
review_findings.phase_gate: Rejects non-complete manifest before accessing selection, intervention or unavailable inputs.

scope_limits: Runtime companion and amendment integration were not reviewed.
Actual request identity mapping and intervention outputs were not inspected.
The unavailable row contract requires an explicit controller-interruption status; runtime must not label it as provider or model failure.
